correctness.rationale: The theorem and degree hypotheses are unchanged; the verdict is for the complete corrected proof in repairs/5. In the frozen proof the residue choice is valid, but the deformation step imports a neighborhood with a relative reduced degeneracy divisor from a cited result that, as proved, supplies only generic equality of canonical degree. Also the general-position local argument for excluding divisorial Cartier zeros should not assume nonvanishing of the pole-cleared wedge at the crossing of the two prime-field-proportional residues. The repair chooses general hypersurfaces: independently varying first jets of two forms whose residue rows have nonzero Cartier minor makes the pair of covectors independent outside a locus of codimension at least n-1>=2. This excludes extra divisorial zeros away from the pole divisor. Along each pole a partner with a nonzero minor gives a nonzero tangential Cartier evaluation by its residue along a transverse partner intersection. The tangent Cartier identity then gives p-curvature vanishing order exactly one. For deformations, Proposition 4.12 converts the generic equality in Lemma 6.3 to constancy of the degeneracy degree M=d+2. Chartwise tangent syzygies generate at codimension one, so their p-curvature evaluations recover the divisorial gcd. The closed projective incidence of degree-M common divisors gives a proper dominating family with unique central divisor. Normal-crossing openness thus applies to an actual relative divisor. Propositions 4.4 and 4.14, together with torsion-freeness of Pic(P^n), make the twisted numerator divided by that divisor a closed rational form; logarithmicity and constant residues follow on the normal crossing locus in codimension two. A proper factorization family specializes its factors to nonempty products of distinct central components; the regular simple-pole residue formula on a transverse line prevents any such product from grouping different central components. This matches the degrees bijectively, proves containment of each dominating component in the closed irreducible logarithmic locus, and completes componentness. It does not give generic reducedness; p=2 is vacuous and equal residues at p|(d_a+d_b) remain outside the stated scope. No finite or formal verification is claimed.

Making distinctness and the weaker per-component Cartier criterion suffice gives a specific extension rather than a relabeling or specialization of a previously stated component theorem.
